note: Device shares are ELAPSED time, the union of the kernel intervals, with the summed figure beside them to show the gap. quantization_loss_ms is a FLOOR on what launch geometry alone wastes: the blocks occupy ceil(waves) wave-times to do waves wave-times of work, which is the same arithmetic whether the grid is smaller than the device or merely leaves a ragged last wave. Occupancy is NOT costed -- a kernel can have a block on every SM and still hold a fraction of the warps its registers allow, and section 4l of the profiling study records ncu's occupancy recommendation being the wrong lever four times here, including a +3.93% regression from doubling it on these very radiation kernels. Read warp_capacity_pct beside the loss, not as part of it. at_register_cap is the family where the lever is splitting the kernel rather than freeing registers, because a kernel at the cap spends any freed register on live state. one_thread_per_column marks the launch shape section 4l diagnosed. Rows under min_ms_per_config are omitted.
